column1: # scheduled-checks.tsv (harbor#1437) — the read-only checks launchd runs from main through bin/check-run.sh.
# A check is here AND in docs/reference/checks.md AND has a launchd plist (launchd/com.harbor.<id>.plist, marker harbor:deploy-installs)
# naming `check-run.sh <id>`. The operator approved scheduling these on 2026-11-02 ("everything must be run automatically"). Not here, and
# still needing an explicit yes: deploy.fleet (`harbor ship`: unattended merges and deploys) and the event spawner.
#   receipt  tool = the command writes its own receipt for the findings reconcile; wrap = check-run.sh writes it from the exit code
#   command  a path inside the tree and its arguments; {cfg} is the config dir
